constraints.name: data_consents_revoke_after
constraints.definition: CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= granted_at)

constraints.name: experience_mentions_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'matched'::text AND person_id IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'matched'::text AND person_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: people_unification_aliases_ck
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(aliases) = 'array'::text THEN jsonb_array_length(aliases) <= 20
    ELSE false
END AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(aliases, '$[*]?(@.type() != "string")'::jsonpath))

constraints.name: people_unification_type_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((person_type = ANY (ARRAY['real'::text, 'fictional'::text])) AND (person_subtype IS NULL OR person_subtype = 'historical'::text AND person_type = 'real'::text OR person_subtype = 'original'::text AND person_type = 'fictional'::text))

constraints.name: person_connection_experience_sources_connection_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, owner_id) REFERENCES lw_core_draft.person_connections(id, owner_id)

constraints.name: person_connection_experience_sources_experience_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (experience_id, owner_id) REFERENCES lw_core_draft.experiences(id, owner_id)

constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (connection_id, subject_experience_id, experience_id)

constraints.name: person_connection_experience_sources_subject_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (subject_experience_id, owner_id) REFERENCES lw_core_draft.subject_experiences(id, owner_id)

constraints.name: person_connections_a_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_a, owner_id) REFERENCES lw_core_draft.people(id, owner_id)

constraints.name: person_connections_b_owner_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_b, owner_id) REFERENCES lw_core_draft.people(id, owner_id)

constraints.name: person_connections_relation_types_ck
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(relation_types) = 'array'::text THEN jsonb_array_length(relation_types) <= 10
    ELSE false
END)

constraints.name: session_turns_generation_fk

constraints.name: subject_experiences_generation_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (origin_type <> 'ai_generated'::text OR generation_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: subject_experiences_generation_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (generation_id, owner_id) REFERENCES lw_core_draft.ai_generations(id, owner_id)

constraints.name: subject_experiences_text_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(raw_text) >= 1 AND length(raw_text) <= 20000 AND length(title) <= 200 AND length(summary) <= 20000)
